_comment: Live-source settings. Put working SACHET feed URLs from your endpoint test into sachet.feeds. Never put API keys here: use the IMD_API_KEY environment variable (or Colab secret / GitHub secret).

imd.notes: IMD describes key-based JWT access and an IP-whitelisting step. If calls fail from your build machine, ask IMD's nodal officer to whitelist it.

imd_geoserver.notes: IMD's own map site uses this public service, but it is not a documented API and terms are unclear. Disabled by default; enable only after IMD's nodal officer confirms programmatic use is allowed.
